top_signals.title: Stock Rally Falters as US-Iran Risk Fuels Oil Gain: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders left stocks and bonds wavering as oil rose after fresh Middle East violence stoked concerns about an escalation of the war that has jolted markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Glencore Backed Radiant World With Warrants Deal in Late 2025
top_signals.summary: Glencore Plc last year acquired warrants that would have given it a minority ownership stake in Radiant World, the iron ore trader under pressure amid concerns it provided falsified documents to banks, according to people familiar with the matter.
